situation (example wording): "share of murders that are intraracial", "what percent of murders are interracial", "share of murders committed by black males"
what the app does today: Declined or asked: these shares are not built.
proposed behavior: SAME RACE (intraracial) = the victim's race equals offender 1's race; INTERRACIAL = they differ. Only murders where BOTH races are known (not U) can be classed: the denominator is those murders, and a note gives how many murders were left out because a race is unknown. "Murders committed by black males" = offender 1 race B and sex M, as a share of ALL murders for the place and period, with the murders whose offender is unknown shown as their own line. Counts and shares are shown, and a share asked for is one sentence (N of M).
exact default or choices offered: Same-race and different-race counts and shares among murders with both races known, plus the left-out count; offender race-and-sex as a share of all murders with an unknown line.
why: Race follows the Homicide Reports categories as published; no race grouping is invented.
